meta.title: How it works
meta.description: From a blank screen to a living display in minutes — connect a screen, compose the content and publish remotely.

hero.title: From a blank screen to a living display — in minutes.
hero.subtitle: No cables, no technician, no code. Three steps stand between you and screens that work for you.

steps.title: Three steps to your first screen.

items.title: Connect a screen
items.body: Install the EdgeRize player on an Android TV box, mini-PC or desktop you already have. Open the screen, scan the QR code from your dashboard — and it's paired. No cables, no technician.

items.title: Compose the content
items.body: Pick from 38 ready-made apps — menus, weather, exchange rates, social feeds — or upload your own images and video. Arrange them into a playlist and split the screen into zones if you like.

items.title: Publish remotely
items.body: Send it to one screen or a whole network. Schedule changes ahead and edit anything in real time — from your phone or laptop, wherever you are.

capabilities.title: Control over the whole network, from one panel.

items.title: Fleet management
items.body: Group screens by location and publish to all at once or one at a time.

items.title: Scheduling
items.body: Different content by hour, day or occasion — prepared in advance.

items.title: On-screen zones
items.body: Split the screen: menu on the left, weather on top, a news ticker below.

items.title: Works offline
items.body: Content is cached and keeps playing without internet; it syncs the moment the connection returns.

items.a: No. EdgeRize runs on an ordinary Android TV, mini-PC or desktop computer you already have.

items.q: What happens if the internet drops?
items.a: The player keeps showing the last content from cache. As soon as the connection returns, it syncs automatically.

items.q: How many screens can I connect?
items.a: From one to a thousand — you manage them all from the same place, with no added complexity.
No. If you can make a social media post, you can manage your screens.
